instruction: A candid studio photograph captures a medium full shot of two women dancing against a plain beige wall. On the left, the woman with an afro in a brown button-up dress (R1) stands facing forward, looking down with a soft expression as she dances with clenched fists. Beside her on the right, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt and white trousers (R2) stands angled left, eyes closed in enjoyment, hands raised mid-motion. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused front lighting, creating a warm, minimalist aesthetic with a shallow depth of field.
elements: R1 dances while facing forward, looking down, and keeping clenched fists
R2 dances with eyes closed and hands raised mid-motion
R2 is angled toward R1 while dancing beside her
R1 has a soft downward-looking expression during the dance
The dancers are photographed against a plain beige wall

questions.element: R1 dances while looking down with clenched fists

questions.element: R2 dances with eyes closed and hands raised mid-motion

questions.element: R1 faces forward and dances with clenched fists
